case_title: CELSO GARCIA ORDONO VS. ENTERPRISE RENT-A-CAR CO.OF SAN FRANCISCO, LLC.

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-20-2015 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ORDONO, CELSO GARCIA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT ENTERPRISE RENT-A-CAR CO.OF SAN FRANCISCO, LLC. PURSUANT TO CCP 116.610 - THE PREVAILING PARTY IS ENTITLED TO THE COSTS OF THE ACTION, INCLUDING THE COSTS OF SERVING THE ORDER FOR THE APPEARANCE OF THE DEFENDANT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT ENTERPRISE RENT-A-CAR CO.OF SAN FRANCISCO, LLC.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-20-2015 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAR-20-2015 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. THE PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. THE DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. THE DEFENDANT WAS REPRESENTED THROUGH BRANN POE (TITLE: CLAIMS REPRESENTATIVE). THE PLAINTIFF'S WITNESS KATHLEEN HAHN IS SWORN AND EXAMINED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED.
